For the heart to be in optimal health, the electrical conductivity should be a normal sinus rhythm (NSR). An NSR is 
a rhythm that originates from the sinus node and is characteristic of a healthy heart’s cardiac rhythm. With an NSR, 
the wave tracing should be within normal measurements, and the deflections and appearances or shapes of all
